fields.Name: T326 - Routine Recipients Add and Reorder
fields.Description: Exercises the dynamic Recipients array editor with per-row user/email mode switching, Sequence reordering (MoveRecipient), and removal — a bespoke repeating-row sub-form unique to routine notification recipients.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, click 'New Routine', expand 'Advanced options', and scroll to the Notifications section's 'Additional recipients' area (it initially says only you the owner will be notified). Click 'Add recipient' once — a recipient row should appear with a mode dropdown (user vs external email), a target field, a channel dropdown, move-up/move-down buttons, and a remove (trash) button. Click 'Add recipient' again to get a second row, then use the down/up arrows to reorder them, and remove one with the trash button. Success is seeing recipient rows added, reordered, and removed — you do NOT need to save.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Add recipient' adds a recipient row with a mode selector, a target field, a channel selector, reorder arrows, and a remove button
A second recipient can be added and the rows can be reordered and/or one removed via the row controls
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
